board.review_advance_has_successor: batch {{.V0}} has planned successor batches ({{.V1}}), and each base is immutable. Remove them first with kander review extend-plan and drop_batches; a removed batch that never ran returns with a new ID after the close
board.review_batch_outside_plan: batch {{.V0}} is not in review plan {{.V2}} of card {{.V1}}. Add the batch with kander review extend-plan before its first run
board.review_cycle_batch_required: a member was rebound after its batches closed, so its new cycle needs a batch: append one with kander review extend-plan. A batch that records N/A with its reason satisfies this
board.review_plan_chain_gap: batch {{.V0}} has base {{.V1}}, and its predecessor {{.V2}} has target {{.V3}}. A batch chain must be continuous: use the target of the predecessor as the base
board.review_plan_worktree_mismatch: run worktree {{.V0}} differs from {{.V1}} of plan {{.V2}}. A plan never moves: recreate the worktree at {{.V1}} and run there
board.review_run_input_conflict: a run replays only with byte-identical inputs. Restore the configuration and pass the frozen task context, or use a new --run-id in the same batch
board.review_superseded_decision_hint: a root run that cannot join the chain closes with a "decision" reference to the user decision in its superseded_runs entry; its findings stay binding
board.review_task_context_frozen: the task context differs from the one batch {{.V0}} froze (publishing a run appends the review index to the live spec.md). Rerun with the frozen snapshot {{.V1}} as the task context and put only execution and fix evidence in the supplemental review context; a change to GOAL, USER_DECISIONS, EXPECTED_OUTCOME, ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA, THREAT_MODEL, or OUT_OF_SCOPE needs a new batch, while ticking acceptance checkboxes does not
board.review_task_context_frozen_no_snap: the task context differs from the one batch {{.V0}} froze, and no run of the batch keeps a copy. Pass the original task context bytes; a new batch is no way out while the plan names this one
board.review_withdrawal_required: assigned finding {{.V0}}/{{.V1}} of excluded member {{.V2}} needs a withdrawn record: submit kander review disposition with status withdrawn, the exclusion ID from kander review progress, and the user decision
board.review_resolve_exclusive: resolve_batch excludes every other extend-plan operation, including seal
board.review_resolve_planned: batch {{.V0}} is in review plan {{.V1}}. resolve_batch handles only a batch outside the plan
board.review_resolve_no_run: batch {{.V0}} has no run, so no gate rejects it
board.review_resolve_no_member: batch {{.V0}} has no member in review plan {{.V1}}
board.review_resolve_member: member {{.V0}} of batch {{.V1}} is not a member of covering batch {{.V2}}
board.review_resolve_role: role {{.V0}} is required in batch {{.V1}}, and covering batch {{.V2}} has no conclusion of a required {{.V0}}
board.review_resolve_cover_unknown: covering batch {{.V0}} is not in review plan {{.V1}}
board.review_resolve_publication: run {{.V0}} has not finished publication. Retry the same run ID first
board.review_resolve_interpret: run {{.V0}} waits for kander review interpret. Submit the interpretation first
board.review_resolve_finding_unknown: resolve_batch names {{.V0}}, which is not a finding of batch {{.V1}}
board.review_resolve_must_fix: must-fix finding {{.V0}} needs fix_commit, or decision with a user decision reference
board.review_resolve_status: finding {{.V0}} needs a basis and a status: fixed or rejected, and deferred only for a finding that is not must-fix
board.review_resolve_fixed: fixed finding {{.V0}} needs a full fix_commit and verification
board.review_resolve_fix_evidence: finding {{.V0}} has fix evidence without the status fixed
board.review_resolve_fix_order: fix_commit of finding {{.V0}} is the reviewed commit {{.V1}}. It must be a later commit
board.review_resolve_stale: resolved batch {{.V0}} changed after its resolution: {{.V1}}
board.review_resolve_failed_report: failed run {{.V0}} kept a report Kander cannot read, so its findings are unknown and this batch cannot be resolved
board.review_decision_unused: decision belongs to drop_batches or release_obligation, and this request has neither
board.review_release_decision: release_obligation needs a non-empty decision: the user decision reference
board.review_release_nothing: member {{.V1}} has no {{.V0}} obligation to release
board.review_release_recovery_roles: the recovery of member {{.V0}} owes {{.V1}}, and a decision does not replace an actual review: append a batch with kander review extend-plan that requires these roles and names the member, then close it
board.review_seal_dropped: cannot seal: a dropped required batch still owes {{.V0}} (member/role). Append a batch that requires the role and names the member, with the seal in the same request, or send release_obligation with a user decision
board.review_dropped_required: a dropped required batch stays owed (dropped-review:<member>/<role>): append a batch with kander review extend-plan that requires the role and names the member, close it, or release it with release_obligation and a user decision. N/A does not count
board.review_stale_conclusion: run {{.V0}} of role {{.V1}} reviewed another execution cycle of member {{.V2}}, so it cannot close batch {{.V3}}. Run role {{.V1}} in this cycle: on a new commit with --advance-file and --previous-run-id, or on the same commit, retiring the old run through superseded_runs
board.review_stale_run_required: a required role has only runs of another execution cycle (stale-run:<batch>/<role>/<member>): run that role in this cycle and close the batch on the new run
